data.name: Birvika

data.long_meaning: Birvika is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bir' (Goddess) and 'Vika' (Fortune). In Hindu mythology, the Goddess of Love and Fortune is known as 'Lakshmi'. Birvika is a tribute to her, representing love, prosperity, and good fortune. The name is believed to bring happiness, success, and abundance in life. The name Birvika carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Birvika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of love and fortune in Hindu tradition.
